name: @oaknational/oak-design-tokens
description: Oak token source files and generated CSS custom properties

scripts.build: pnpm exec tsx src/build.ts && pnpm exec tsup src/terminal-theme.ts --format esm --out-dir dist && pnpm exec tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.validate-design-system-consistency: cd ../../.. && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@oaknational/design-tokens-core --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm exec tsx packages/design/oak-design-tokens/scripts/validate-design-system-consistency.ts
